name: Lantern Moth
notes: DRAFT for C13-1 (bestiary-plan.md). Flutters at a distance and tosses soft glow pebbles. Stats are TODO for the Researcher (ENEMY_SCALE). Distances in tiles, times in ticks (20 per second).
tell: red circle where the pebble lands
senseiLine: Where does the circle land? Step out, then step in.
description: Flutters at a distance and tosses soft glow pebbles.

bestiary.tip: Step out of the circle, then close in.

lore.white: It used to dance around the hall lamps. Free it, and it flutters home to the light.
